featured_reviews.name: Faisal Khan
featured_reviews.review_text:
⭐☆☆☆☆ – Not Recommended

Had a very disappointing experience with Wajid Pet Shop, Jogeshwari West.

I purchased a Sun Conure along with a cage for ₹14,000, and shortly after bringing the bird home, I noticed it was weak and unwell. After consulting an avian vet, I was informed that the bird was suffering from a lung infection and had swelling in one of its organs. Apart from the stress of seeing a sick bird, I also had to spend an additional ₹2,800 on veterinary treatment.

The seeds and bird food provided by this shop were also in poor condition and appeared old and stale. As a pet owner, you trust the seller to provide healthy birds and proper care guidance, which unfortunately was not the case here.

What disappointed me the most was the complete lack of after-sales support. While purchasing, the owner was extremely friendly and attentive. However, once the sale was completed and I raised concerns regarding the bird's health, my calls and messages were ignored. There was no effort to listen, assist, or resolve the issue.

Buying a pet is not like buying an ordinary product—it's a living being that requires proper care and responsibility. Based on my experience, I would not recommend this shop to anyone looking to purchase birds or pets. Please do your research and consider getting a health check done immediately if you decide to buy from here.
